title: A new way to support Pollinations
summary:
Ko-fi joined the ways to support Pollinations, while the homepage news list got a small cleanup.

The homepage gained a floating Ko-fi “Tip Us” widget and a news entry explaining Ko-fi support, including the option to connect a Discord account for premium roles. GitHub’s funding links and the website’s funding details were updated, and the homepage news list no longer repeats its lead story.

highlights.title: Support through Ko-fi
highlights.text: The homepage now has a Ko-fi “Tip Us” widget, with an option to connect a Discord account for premium roles. [Visit Pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).
